note: Fictional AI illustrations, not actual patient results. Neutral daylight palette. Before and after generated as matched edits. High frequency illustrates grooming only.

assets.name: hair-dandruff-v2
assets.prompt: Close top-down view of parted black hair on adult South Asian woman's scalp. Small visible dry white dandruff flakes at roots.
assets.edit: Reduce only loose flakes, retain a few flakes and exactly same hair strands and scalp.

assets.name: hair-fall-v2
assets.prompt: Overhead crown of adult South Asian man with short black hair and moderate natural thinning, some visible scalp between hairs.
assets.edit: Modestly increase hair density in thinning area; retain visible scalp and natural residual thinning.

assets.name: hair-scalp-psoriasis-v2
assets.prompt: Close rear three-quarter view of adult South Asian person's ear and hairline with a small scaly psoriasis patch, medium brown skin, dark hair tied up.
assets.edit: Reduce only scale and irritation of patch, retain visible residual discolouration and some scaling.

assets.name: hair-prp-v2
assets.prompt: Close overhead view of adult South Asian man's crown with black hair and mild diffuse thinning. Heather grey shirt collar at bottom.
assets.edit: Show modestly denser hair at crown, with residual thinning and scalp still visible, no full hair restoration.

assets.name: hair-microneedling-v2
assets.prompt: Close top-down view of adult South Asian woman's central part with black hair and mild thinning around a widened part. Faded blue shirt at bottom.
assets.edit: Show modestly denser hair around part, with part and some visible scalp still remaining, not perfect density.

assets.name: hair-high-frequency-v2
assets.prompt: Close view of parted black hair on adult South Asian person's scalp with scattered loose surface flakes and mild oily clumping of roots.
assets.edit: Illustrate scalp after routine grooming only: slightly fewer loose flakes and less clumped hair. No new hair growth or change in density; preserve hairline and part.
